title: Incorrect claim that `inspect.getattr_static` and built-in `getattr` function have identical signatures in `inspect` documentation
author: jonathandung
body_preview: ### Documentation  `getattr` doesn't take keyword arguments, while `inspect.getattr_static` does. Besides, [its documentation](https://docs.python.org/3/library/inspect.html#inspect.getattr_static) represents the default of the `default` parameter as `None`, whereas it is an unrepresentable sentinel at runtime.  <!-- gh-linked-prs --> ### Linked PRs * gh-150504 <!-- /gh-linked-prs -->
